text:
hana: quick sync idea 60s: run a small launch experiment combining webinar invites + differentiated onboarding hooks. three funnels: A) instant 45 credits + a 2-template starter pack, B) guided in-product walkthrough (no upfront credits) + promised office hours, C) 75 credits but gated by attending the webinar. goal: improve 3-day activation and time-to-first-success. can infra support randomized routing at signup?

kevin: yes for routing. randomize at signup and persist. prefer grant-on-first-success for credit arms to avoid farming. can we also filter out public emails (gmail/yahoo)? @ops-bot

ops-bot: experiment created: id lp-2026-07-launchpad. assignment: randomized at signup, stored in user.attrs.experiments.lp_launchpad. grant triggers on event:first_success for credit arms. whitelist: email_domain not in [gmail.com,yahoo.com,hotmail.com]. doc: https://redwood.internal/experiments/lp-2026-07-launchpad

li: analytics asks: tag events with experiment_id, arm, first_success_ts, webinar_attended boolean, referral_source, and initial_token_count. i'll run cohort comparisons and post a simple dashboard. please ensure grant webhooks include experiment metadata.

sara: creative plan: 2 subject lines per arm, 1 social teaser, 1 landing page hero that highlights "earn credits by using" for the guided flow. i'll post copy drafts by Thu EOD.

hana: ops constraints: pilot spend cap $3k, per-user cap 80 credits. prefer to expire credits after 10 days to focus activation. also set daily cap to reduce early burn.

kevin: note on measurement: use time_to_first_success (hours) and conversion to trial paid within 14d. also track promptpack usage: which templates get used most.

amir: prompt checklist: include templates for "email-drafting", "code-assist", "meeting-summary", and 2 micro-examples each. i'll sanitize and compress examples.

li: can we stratify by webinar RSVP vs attended? want to compare attendance uplift inside each arm. will add webinar_attended boolean as a stratifier.

sara: email cadence suggestion: welcome email immediately, 24h "nudge" with a use-case, 48h final nudge plus webinar invite. for webinar-gated credits send a calendar hold and a post-webinar challenge to unlock credits.

hana: ops payload for grants (paste for eng): ```json
{"experiment_id":"lp-2026-07-launchpad","arm":"credits_instant","credits":45,"cap_per_user":80,"expires_days":10}
```

kevin: routing detail: randomize evenly across arms; keep a small baseline control (no credits, just webinar invite + guided tips) of ~150 users for benchmark narrative. will implement in infra and emit grant_status events.

amir: posting promptpacks in this thread shortly. will label them by arm and tag any potentially sensitive examples.

li: analytics owners: @li lead analysis, @kevin validate instrumentation, @amir validate promptpack telemetry. i'll publish the first-week report next Wed.

sara: posting creative comps in #marketing now. pls react with :eyes: so i know when to finalize.

hana: final checklist: creative Thu EOD, routing + grant infra Fri noon, analytics events live before launch. launch Monday AM if green. keep updates here and call out blockers asap. :rocket:
